title: Red Pesto Gnocchi
subtitle: with Roasted Zucchini and Walnuts
description: Whether you're a full-time or part-time vegetarian, this meat-free dish serves up taste and texture galore. Think pillowy potato gnocchi, roasted veggies and crunchy toasted walnuts – all tossed together in a fuss-free red pesto sauce.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the gnocchi (see Kitchen 101). Cut the tomato into 2cm-thick wedges. Cut the onion into 1cm-thick wedges. Halve the zucchini lengthwise and thinly slice. Coarsely chop the walnuts.

Bake veggies: Put the tomato, onion, zucchini and 2 unpeeled garlic cloves on the lined tray. Drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Bake for 6-8 mins until the veggies are softened. Scatter over the walnuts and bake for a further 3-4 mins until the walnuts are toasted and the veggies are golden and tender.
Cook gnocchi: While the walnuts are toasting, add the gnocchi to the pan of boiling water, stir to separate, then return to the boil and cook for 3 mins. Drain.
Add pesto: Squeeze the roasted garlic from the skins, put in a large bowl and mash with a fork. Add the pesto and 1 tbs tomato paste, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Serve up: Add the baked veggies, walnuts and gnocchi to the pesto mixture and toss to coat. Divide the pesto gnocchi among plates and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Make sure the water is at a rapid boil before adding the gnocchi to prevent them becoming soggy.
